format: C++/CX (Component Extensions for Runtime) with Windows Runtime (WinRT) syntax
description: This file defines a class 'DisplayExpressionToken' used in the Calculator application's ViewModel to represent tokens in a display expression, including properties for token text, position, type, and edit mode status.

classes.name: DisplayExpressionToken
classes.description: A sealed runtime class representing a token in a calculator display expression, with observable properties for data binding and property change notifications.

methods.name: DisplayExpressionToken (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of DisplayExpressionToken with specified token text, position, editability, and type.

methods.name: IsTokenInEditMode (property)
methods.description: Gets or sets whether the token is currently in edit mode, updating the original token when exiting edit mode.
